text:
Date: March 14, 2024, when the audit summary was released to the county board.
Named person: Dana Whitlock, Brisco County Chief Auditor, who presented the findings.
Figure: 212 items valued at $48,600, including laptops, projectors, and e-reader tablets.
Source document: The "Brisco County Public Library System Asset Review, FY2023," a 37-page report.
